title: Architecture element v1
description: config/architecture/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F3a): an element of the engine's architecture (a system, a component, a contract or a port) with no other home. It declares the requirements it satisfies and the elements it depends on; the units that realize it say so in their own manifests (units/<id>/unit.json `realizes`). A capability (docs/capabilities/) is read where it is.

statement.description: What the element is responsible for, in one or two sentences.

depends_on.description: The elements it may depend on (the declared side of the reflexion model).
